title: A Future She Chooses follow-up (marriage retry)

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I have thought about what you asked. I would not like you to mistake my answer for a puzzle with a secret password.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “You want a life together where neither of us has to turn into someone else.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Yes. I can make room for love. I cannot promise that my work and my home will vanish to make it.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The water laps at the quay. She is patient about it. She is also not going to answer the wrong question.

options.labelText: “I love you as you are. Marry me, and we’ll plan a future with room for your home and your duties, and for mine?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “That is the future I was trying to describe.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I’ll mark it on the tide chart. High water: {PLAYER} listened.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She takes your hand across the waterline. With the other, she makes a note.

options.labelText: “If we marry, I’ll take care of all the planning. You won’t have to make decisions anymore.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I appreciate help. I have no intention of retiring from having a will of my own.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “Trying to spare you the stress, that’s all.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Then trust me to tell you when I need help. Ask again when you mean that.”
